Third-Party Package Updates in Splunk Universal Forwarder - July 2026
Advisory ID:
SVD-2026-0706
CVE ID:
Multiple
Published:
2026-07-15
Last Update:
2026-08-14
Description
Splunk remedied common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs) in Third Party Packages in Splunk Universal Forwarder versions 10.4.1, 10.2.5, 10.0.8, 9.4.13, and higher.
Package
Remediation
CVE
Severity
OpenSSL
1
Upgraded OpenSSL to version 1.0.2zp and 3.5.6
Multiple
Medium
1
Upgraded OpenSSL to version 1.0.2zp to remedy CVE-2026-28388, CVE-2026-28389, and CVE-2026-28390 at
$SPLUNK_HOME/lib/libcrypto.so.1.0.0
and
$SPLUNK_HOME/lib/libssl.so.1.0.0
for Splunk Enterprise version 9.4.13. Upgraded OpenSSL to version 3.5.6 at /opt/splunk/bin/openssl to remedy CVE-2026-31789, CVE-2026-31790 for Splunk Enterprise versions 10.4.1, 10.2.5, 10.0.8.
Solution
Upgrade Splunk Universal Forwarder to versions 10.4.1, 10.2.5, 10.0.8, 9.4.13, or higher.
